# Three.js 0.180.0

Vendored from the official `three@0.180.0` npm distribution via jsDelivr.
All modules and addons use this same version. See LICENSE for the MIT license.
Only the WebGL core, glTF loader/exporter and their geometry utility are included.
The exporter is used by the development model generator, not loaded by the homepage.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
